> AOI is a desktop AI companion with a physical OLED face. A Python-based AI system processes user input and converts the AI's emotional state into animated expressions displayed on an SSD1306 OLED through an Arduino Uno. For this warm-up, I am rebuilding and improving AOI's physical interface, firmware, and Python-to-Arduino communication
